## Passages
RESULT [agents]: o1-preview with AIDE reached a medal in 16.9% of competitions at pass@1 and 34.1% at pass@8. GPT-4o gained only modestly from 100h vs 24h (8.7% to 11.8%). Obfuscated vs original descriptions gave 8.4% vs 8.5%, and there was no correlation between pretraining familiarity and score.
US [agents]: Two transferable practices: automatic log auditing for rule breaks (an LLM reading the trainer's logs for holdout access or hand-edited metrics), and the observation that more attempts help far more than more hours. Several short parallel increment candidates, each gated, beat one long run. That fits the cluster's walltime limits.
CORRECTION [agents]: Confirmed: 75 competitions, 16.9% pass@1 / 34.1% pass@8, GPT-4o 8.7% (24h) -> 11.8% (100h), obfuscation 8.4% vs 8.5%, no familiarity correlation, GPT-4o-mini log inspector, Dolos vs top 50 notebooks.
